model_config.host_context: Apple M4 Max laptop (48 GB), macOS, release build of the measured commit; BSD /usr/bin/time -l. Task E16-31 before/after pair. after: task E16-31 at 8ae605d, RFC-0026 A12 (Proposed) profile byte 3 (multiplicity sources Circle rate 1/4, Policy 2). One prove-dev and one verify-dev run per commit, before then after, back to back; not a median (prove walls [157.34] s; verify walls [6.3] s). Host: other agents' sessions open but idle at the start; 1-minute load average 5.39 to 8.27 sampled before each run (load.log). Controls and model commitment are one run each. Counters proof_section_* are the container section bytes (RFC-0026 §4.1): the before values equal the E16-30 after ledger (byte-identical proof); after = before with the multiplicity certificates 1856144 bytes smaller (measured on the synthetic pins; the 21 checks are the same tables on every rung) and the rest of the drop in the lookup section (multiplicity openings); the sum plus the unchanged container framing equals the proof size. Inputs: the E16-30 prepared files (SHA-256 as model below). One run each, so the prove and verify time deltas are not significant; byte counts are exact.

note: RFC-0026 development profile (RFC-0018 A1): no security level, FS unproven, PCS conjectural, no zero-knowledge. Prover time is the prove-dev process wall time: Artifact decode, weight commitment, executor capture (witness), plain check and proof; the witness is not timed separately (witness_recompute_ns 0). Stage model_commitment, when present, is Artifact decode plus model commitment timed in a separate test process; it is part of prove_dev_wall. Verifier time is the verify-dev process wall time. CPU only, no GPU; threads is the hardware thread count available to the process. Peak RSS is the BSD /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size. Controls are the four statement tampers of rejects_tampers_on_a_supplied_proof against this proof, each rejected by the verifier with the header restamped. Not comparable to W1-W8 records; not a cost-model fit input.
